_level_commits: commits per square, sitting a notch ABOVE each observed band threshold (L1>=1, L2>=6, L3>=11, L4>=16 as measured 2026-10-18). The margin absorbs normal drift; verify.py tops up anything that still lands pale. Bands scale with the busiest day of the trailing year, and our own L4 days are expected to be that maximum, which makes the arrangement self-stabilising.
_overhead: MEASURED on day 0, not assumed. With the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN both the PR and the merge commit are attributed to github-actions[bot], not to Felipe, so NEITHER counts toward his graph: overhead is 0 and every contribution must come from a hand-made commit. If COMMITZILLA_TOKEN (a PAT) is ever added, the PR and merge commit start counting as his and this MUST be raised to 2 -- otherwise every square overshoots by two, and an overshoot cannot be undone.

_calibration.finding: 3 hand-made commits counted; PR opened by bot counted 0; merge commit by bot counted 0
